blocks.text: The holidays are a season of giving, gathering, and celebrating the people who have made the year meaningful. This spirit comes to life across the grounds of South Palms Resort & Spa Panglao – MGallery Collection as its signature rattan Christmas tree makes a return for the second year. Standing 14 feet tall and adorned with sustainable materials, including woven raffia, the centerpiece is not only a product of Boholano craftsmanship but also a tribute to the resort’s Heartists—the people whose creativity, passion, and dedication contribute to the destination’s continued growth and success.
